name: benchmark-queries
description: A collection of benchmark queries designed to evaluate models' ability to retrieve relevant information and produce correct answers. The dataset contains diverse query types (factual, conversational, and information-seeking) and is intended for testing retrieval and answer-generation pipelines. Evaluations focus on relevance and correctness of returned results.
reputation: Relatively low-to-moderate adoption in the community; primarily used in niche retrieval/IR experiments rather than as a broad LLM benchmark.
